grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Saturday in My Town
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或读文字稿），然后完成8道题。单选题选一个最合适的答案；填空题答案必须来自原文，注意字数限制。所有解释为中文。
transcript: Last Saturday, I was at the market with my friend Anna. The market was very crowded. We bought some fruit and bread. Then we were at a small shop near the market. The shop was clean and quiet. Anna was happy because the shop had cheap bags. I was tired because the market was big. Next Saturday, we are going to visit a museum. Anna is going to bring her camera because she likes photos. I am going to buy a ticket for the museum. We are going to meet at ten o'clock.

questions.explanation: 原文说“The market was very crowded.”，所以市场很拥挤。

grammar.title: was/were 与 be going to 入门
grammar.explanation: was/were 表示过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。be going to 表示计划，结构是 am/is/are going to + 动词原形。because 表示原因，后面接原因。
grammar.example: The market was very crowded. We are going to visit a museum because we like old things.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子（过去时）：
options: I was at the market yesterday.
I were at the market yesterday.
I am at the market yesterday.
answers: I was at the market yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语I在過去时用was，所以“I was at the market yesterday.”正确。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday, I was at the market with my friend Anna.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子（be going to 表计划）：
options: We are going to visit a museum.
We is going to visit a museum.
We going to visit a museum.
answers: We are going to visit a museum.
questions.explanation: 主语we用are，结构是are going to + 动词原形，所以“We are going to visit a museum.”正确。
questions.evidence: Next Saturday, we are going to visit a museum.

questions.prompt: 根据原文，Anna为什么高兴？选择与原文意思一致的句子：
options: Anna was happy because the shop had cheap bags.
Anna was happy so the shop had cheap bags.
Anna was happy but the shop had cheap bags.
answers: Anna was happy because the shop had cheap bags.
questions.explanation: 原文用because说明原因：商店有便宜的包。so和but不表示原因，所以选because的句子。
questions.evidence: Anna was happy because the shop had cheap bags.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子（过去时）：
options: They were at the shop yesterday.
They was at the shop yesterday.
They are at the shop yesterday.
answers: They were at the shop yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语they在過去时用were，所以“They were at the shop yesterday.”正确。
questions.evidence: Then we were at a small shop near the market.
